description: Pilot template showing how to ship **markdown** evidence inline on the architecture request. Useful when ADR excerpts, runbook fragments, or threat-model notes exist as text and should ride with the run for provenance.
assumptions: Markdown bodies are non-secret; redact before upload if they reference production hostnames

documents.name: ADR-014-api-edge.md
documents.content:
# ADR 014 — API edge

## Context
Public HTTP API on Azure Front Door + WAF.

## Decision
Terminate TLS at Front Door; origin is private App Service.

## Status
Accepted
